before:
For the equation-generated Do\v{s}en--Petri\'c presentation, cut
elimination and Boolean Coherence are proved in Lean. The development
constructs normalization, signed-label preservation, and uniform
whole-arrow substitution, and supplies the full presentation as an
instance of every hypothesis of \texttt{relative\_maximality}. The theorem
\texttt{Presentation.maximality} gives the resulting maximality statement.
after:
For the presentation defining $\B(P)$, the development proves cut
elimination and Boolean Coherence and constructs normalization,
signed-label preservation, and uniform substitution on arrow terms
and their source and target formulas. These constructions verify the
hypotheses of \texttt{relative\_maximality}. The theorem
\texttt{Presentation.maximality} proves maximality of $\B(P)$.
